recording.serverBody: The server may be starting or temporarily unavailable. Your session has not been cleared. We’ll check the connection and return you to the page when it is ready.
recording.serverTakingLonger: This is taking longer than usual. Please try again shortly.
recording.shareHint: Choose a local church. Only authorised staff signed in to that church can submit through this link.
recording.localHint: This form is locked to your assigned local church. Sign-in and church permissions are checked again when you submit.
recording.restrictedBody: Only authorised staff assigned to this local church can submit here. Sign in with the correct church account, or ask your church administrator to check your assignment. District and national oversight accounts can review reports from their normal workspace.
recording.customHint: Choose a common service or enter the name used by your church.
